info.title: TREVV API
info.description: Versioned, permission-scoped contracts shared by the TREVV Web, Mobile, and Desktop clients. Health, this OpenAPI document, and provider-managed /api/auth/* endpoints are public; product routes require both a Better Auth session and X-Organization-Id in live mode.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Limit signals to one accessible Workspace.

200.description: Meaningful changes since the user checkpoint
Snapshots, review rituals, and decision outcomes
Demo Blueprint versions, instances, and safe update preview
Demo dry-run mapping and unsupported-data report

201.description: Created work item or exact replay of the original create

SessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
SessionCookie.description: Better Auth session cookie. Production may apply the standard __Secure- cookie prefix; clients must obtain the cookie through the public /api/auth/* endpoints.

OrganizationContext.name: X-Organization-Id
OrganizationContext.description: Required in live mode. The server verifies this selection against the authenticated user's active membership.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A UUID scoped to the selected organization and authenticated user. Reusing it with the same request returns the original status and body; reusing it with a different request returns 409.

OptionalIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
OptionalIdempotencyKey.description: Optional UUID for exact replay. When supplied, the key also binds the current If-Match value.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong numeric ETag returned by the resource, from "0" through "2147483647"; for example "3".

ETag.description: Strong quoted PostgreSQL integer resource version, from "0" through "2147483647".

IdempotencyKey.description: The validated idempotency key used for this mutation. Present when a key was supplied.

IdempotencyReplayed.description: Whether this status and body are an exact replay of a previously committed mutation. Present when an idempotency key was supplied.

OrganizationContextRequired.description: X-Organization-Id is required in live mode and must select an organization in which the authenticated user has an active membership.

Conflict.description: The resource version is stale, or an idempotency key was reused for a different request.

PreconditionRequired.description: A current quoted ETag is required in If-Match.

RepositoryUnavailable.description: The live PostgreSQL repository is unavailable.

CapabilityUnavailable.description: This capability is deliberately unavailable in live mode during Phase 1.
